jobs.title: Agent Engineer, Luna Tel-Aviv, IL
jobs.description: Agent Engineer, Luna | Apply today at monday.com Apply to this job Agent Engineer, Luna FullTime Tel-Aviv, IL Luna is a new startup inside monday.com Agent Labs , founded and run by monday.com 's CEO, the program that spins up independent startups from scratch. Each one runs like a seed-stage company: a tiny team, a real product, real users, with monday.com 's backing and distribution. Luna already has a live product , a pile of open problems nobody has answered yet, and no layers between you and the person making the calls. We're hiring the engineer who builds it. You work directly with the founder, monday.com 's CEO . Decisions happen in the conversation, not in a roadmap review. You own the engineering. The founder owns the product. What we're building Meet Luna , the first generation of autonomous agents, which proved that agents can do real work. It also proved they broke. Unbounded self-coding that can touch any key. Everything is riding on raw LLM reasoning, so execution drifts. No way to see what actually happened. Luna is the second generation. It still learns and improves itself, but on a scaffold built for trust: Deterministic workflows, the agent writes and refines, then runs on a real engine instead of re-reasoning every time. A one-way vault. Secrets resolve below the plugin layer and never enter the model's context. Rollback on every change, an audit trail on every action, and approval gates on anything sensitive. Everything else is a plugin: tools, channels, skills, isolated per agent. Luna isn't a chatbot. You describe the goal, it builds the workflow, you correct it, and it runs reliably next time. A private Luna spins up in about a minute today. There's no playbook yet for what a good agent is in this context. We're writing it with real use cases and real constraints. That's the job. Who we're looking for An experienced builder at heart. You'd rather ship the thing than pitch it. This is an engineering role, not a founder track. Instincts about agents. Before writing a line, you ask what the model must never be allowed to touch, how you'd know it failed, and what happens when it does. Shipping ten agents isn't required. Having thought hard about one is. Independent. Hand you something vague, and you come back with something that works. Strong fundamentals in distributed systems and reliability, with production experience. Nice-to-have: LLM tooling in production, tool use, sandboxing, and evals. A security-minded way of building. jobs.description: AI Engineer (render.ai) | Apply today at monday.com Apply to this job AI Engineer (render.ai) FullTime Tel-Aviv, IL Meet render.ai, monday.com 's new AI venture. At render.ai , we're redefining how humans use AI for work. render.ai enables anyone to bring ideas to life in minutes, using their words. jobs.title: How to use AI in our hiring process ✦
jobs.description: monday.com Work Platform | Made For Work, Designed To Love AI in your hiring journey AI is a huge part of how we work and build at monday.com, and we’re all for using it to move faster and think bigger. Chances are, it’s part of how you work too. That’s not a problem, and in fact - we expect it. We created this guide to give clarity on how AI fits into our hiring process, and where it should (and shouldn’t) play a role. Bottom line: We believe in working smarter, as long as your voice and critical thinking stay at the center. Note: These are general guidelines. You may receive more specific AI guidance as part of your interview prep materials, tailored to the specific role and process. Job Applying & Researching AI is a great tool to help you organize your thoughts and get up to speed on our world. Use it to showcase your real experience clearly and to come prepared with deep questions. ✓︎ Do: • Use AI to research monday.com, our product, and our space. • Use it to structure your CV and describe your experience in a clear, focused way. ✗ Don’t: • Let AI fabricate experience or skills you don’t have. We hire you for your real journey. • Treat AI summaries as the whole picture or skip the chance to go a level deeper. Working on Assignments AI can help you move faster, but true ownership comes from being the master of your tools - not the other way around. You’re still responsible for the decisions, the trade-offs, and the final result. ✓︎ Do: • Use AI to explore ideas, build code skeletons, or sense-check your logic. • Be open about how you approach solutions. ✗ Don’t: • Submit work you can’t explain. • Rely entirely on AI-generated output. Live Interviewing We value transparency and genuinely want to meet you - to see how you collaborate, think on your feet, and solve problems in real-time. ✓︎ Do: • Use AI to prepare - simulate interview questions or go deeper on technical topics. • In some cases, you’ll be invited to use AI during the interview to show how you work with it in real time. ✗ Don’t: • Use undisclosed AI tools (like live prompts or bots). • Let AI answer in your place. Transparency goes both ways Just as we encourage you to use AI thoughtfully, we use it to work smarter, too. Whether it’s helping us write clearer job descriptions or managing high volumes of applications, AI is a tool we use to improve the candidate experience - not to replace the human element. At monday.com, AI is a tool, not a decision-maker. Every final decision is made by a human. It comes down to one simple rule: Use AI to improve your work, not replace your thinking. We see AI as a powerful partner that can help you explore new angles and refine your work. But it’s your intuition, creativity, and unique thought process that truly make you a valuable candidate at monday.com. How we build and work with AI Explore open positions
